ctx.x: Irving. Irving Jordan. Irving Jordan. And Irving introduced me to the folks from -- you know, at the

Dunbar Hotel, and at the club. At that time the Club Alabam. I don't know how I got into the Club Alabam. I didn't talk about that, oh my gracious me, well that was something. The thing that was so exciting, Pat, when I first came here, was the fact that everybody, anybody who was anybody went to Central Avenue, you see. This Club Alabam was the living end. It was just something else, really. I saw people there that I, you know, had heard about, read about, you know. You couldn't say you had seen them because you…
